content.intro: This lesson covers Thread Pools and Task Distribution. It sits in Module 16, Concurrency and Parallel Programming, and builds toward a practical Rust mental model rather than memorizing a term in isolation.
content.why_it_matters: Thread Pools and Task Distribution matters when you work with safe coordination across concurrent tasks. Understanding the rule helps you predict compiler or runtime behavior, document assumptions, and choose a safer implementation when inputs or system conditions change.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: Concurrency coordinates multiple tasks that may overlap in time. Rust uses ownership, Send/Sync bounds, message passing, and synchronization types to make shared access explicit.
